name: Product Slider
summary: Finite, user-controlled horizontal product list that composes Carousel scrolling, canonical Icon Button controls, and canonical Product Card items without autoplay or looping.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Contextual section named by its visible heading and layered on the canonical Carousel root.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Intrinsic header row containing the title and optional navigation.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading that names the section and product list.

anatomy.name: nav
anatomy.description: Named group for optional finite previous and next controls.

anatomy.name: navButton
anatomy.description: Canonical Carousel Icon Button for previous or next product navigation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Keyboard-focusable native horizontal list layered on the canonical Carousel track.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item and canonical Carousel snap item.

anatomy.name: productCard
anatomy.description: Exactly one canonical Product Card rendered in each list item.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic two, three, or four-card density derived from the Product Slider container.

states.name: first
states.description: First item is nearest logical start and previous navigation is disabled.

states.name: middle
states.description: An interior item is nearest logical start and both adjacent directions are available.

states.name: last
states.description: Last reachable item is nearest logical start and next navigation is disabled.

states.name: noOverflow
states.description: The supplied list fits in the track and both optional controls are disabled or omitted.

states.name: trackFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the native product-list viewport.

behavior.name: carouselComposition
behavior.description: Product Slider consumes canonical Carousel root, native track, snap item, finite control, focus, RTL, forced-colors, and reduced-motion behavior.

behavior.name: horizontalScroll
behavior.description: The native list scrolls horizontally and complete Product Card items snap to logical start.

behavior.name: navigation
behavior.description: Optional canonical Icon Buttons target exact adjacent items and expose finite disabled bounds; when activation disables the focused boundary control, focus moves to the named track instead of the document.

behavior.name: directScrolling
behavior.description: Direct native scrolling synchronizes the nearest logical-start item and both navigation bounds.

behavior.name: productCardComposition
behavior.description: Every item delegates product media, navigation, Price, Badge, and Quick Look semantics to canonical Product Card.

behavior.name: containerDensity
behavior.description: Card density responds to the Product Slider container rather than the viewport.

behavior.name: finiteCollection
behavior.description: v1 does not autoplay or loop; empty collections are omitted by the owning target.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible product-collection heading and source of the section and track accessible name.

properties.name: previousLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible action name required when the optional previous control is rendered.

properties.name: nextLabel
properties.description: Localized accessible action name required when the optional next control is rendered.

properties.name: navigation
properties.description: Optional canonical previous and next Icon Button composition; targets disable or omit it when the collection does not overflow.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Non-empty consumer-owned collection of canonical Product Cards.

accessibility: Use a visible contextual heading to name the section and the focusable native product list.
Preserve native list semantics and normal Product Card link/button Tab order; do not add a second composite arrow-key model.

Expose localized previous and next Icon Button names, aria-controls, and native disabled bounds; retain control focus while another item is reachable and move focus to the named track when the activated control becomes disabled.
Synchronize finite bounds after buttons, touch, wheel, scrollbar, or keyboard scrolling and target exact items instead of physical offsets.
Preserve canonical Carousel focus, reduced-motion, forced-colors, and RTL behavior and do not autoplay or loop in v1.

web.notes: Product Slider CSS layers container-driven product density on canonical Carousel, Icon Button, and Product Card classes; the target owns the finite item index and exact-item synchronization.

shopify.notes: The related-products section loads Product Recommendations through Section Rendering, composes canonical Product Card snippets, localizes controls, omits empty results, and owns bounded target scrolling.
